content: I'll be at a lunch meeting for the next hour and a half. Will you please tell anyone who calls that I will call them back later this afternoon? And if anyone comes to the office, it just have them wait until I come back.
Yes, Mr. Roberts. What if they are there waiting for a long time? Should I offer them anything?
You can show them the new video we made for the company.
OK, I will do that, Mr. Roberts. I'll take care of everything while you're out.
